propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflows saturate the GitHub Actions Free plan concurrent job limit (20 total, 5 macOS), causing pre-merge runner queues of 22+ jobs and wait times exceeding 14 minutes.
The incident was misattributed to tickets-branch pushes; the tickets branch has no workflows and produced zero Actions runs; actual demand came from main branch workflow_dispatch and scheduled runs.

Current Verified workflow per-run slot cost is 17 jobs (no mutation) to 24 jobs (all shards); immediate fan-out of 13 jobs after classification creates peak theoretical demand of 19 jobs, with macOS as a persistent shared-limit bottleneck.

Independent-change dispatch bursts (three simultaneous full routes) request 39 immediate jobs at Free plan capacity of 20, forcing repository-local queue depth of 22+ and observed 197-873 second runner waits.

Option A (bundle preflights, cap mutation at 3 parallel) reduces immediate fan-out from 13 to 10 jobs and maximum run cost from 24 to 21 with no coverage loss and roughly zero latency impact, addressing independent-burst saturation.
